title: Gerente de PLD
description:
Sobre nós


A Kiwify é uma das maiores plataformas de infoprodutos do Brasil, possibilitando que qualquer pessoa crie e venda seus cursos online.


Somos acelerados pela Y Combinator, do Vale do Silício, e hoje já impactamos milhões de usuários.


Agora estamos dando o próximo passo e criando a Conta Digital da Kiwify, que já nasce com alcance massivo e um canal único de distribuição através dos maiores influenciadores do país.


Acreditamos que a Kiwify se tornará uma das maiores contas digitais do Brasil, e queremos pessoas excepcionais para construir essa história com a gente.



Modelo


  • Remoto



Período


  • Segunda à sexta, das 09h às 18h00 (1h de intervalo)



Benefícios


  • VR/VA – R$ 1.000,00 (Flash Benefícios)
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • WellHub – Gympass



Responsabilidades


  • Liderar o time de PLD e Compliance, garantindo processos robustos de prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro, prevenção a fraudes e financiamento ao terrorismo.


  • Desenvolver políticas, normas e procedimentos alinhados às regulamentações do Banco Central e melhores práticas de mercado.


  • Implementar e aprimorar sistemas de monitoramento de transações suspeitas, alertas e relatórios regulatórios.


  • Conduzir investigações internas e análises de clientes, colaboradores, fornecedores e parceiros (KYC, KYE, KYP e Due Diligence).


  • Assegurar a entrega tempestiva e correta de reportes obrigatórios (COAF, Bacen, entre outros).


  • Trabalhar lado a lado com áreas de Risco, Operações e Jurídico para mitigar riscos regulatórios e reputacionais.


  • Fomentar uma cultura de conformidade dentro da empresa, com treinamentos recorrentes e comunicação clara.



Requisitos


  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em posição de liderança em PLD/Compliance em fintechs, bancos ou instituições financeiras.


  • Experiência em desenvolver e implementar políticas, normas e procedimentos de PLD alinhados às exigências regulatórias e melhores práticas internacionais.


  • Conhecimento sólido das regulamentações brasileiras (BACEN, COAF, CVM, SUSEP) e normas internacionais (FATF, OFAC, AMLD).


  • Experiência comprovada em liderar times de PLD, contratar, treinar e desligar profissionais da área.


  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e times de PLD em empresas em rápido crescimento.


  • Forte senso de urgência, responsabilidade e mentalidade hands-on.


  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e com alta capacidade de alinhamento interdepartamental.

title: Liferay Developer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.


  • Note: This is a 3-month contract position with the possibility of extension , based on performance and project needs.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Computer Engineering.
  • 6+ years of professional experience working with Java-based platforms .
  • Hands-on experience with Liferay DXP as both administrator and developer.
  • Proven experience performing Liferay upgrades, deployments, and DevOps-related tasks .
  • Strong fundamentals in Java, JSP, and Portlet development .
  • Experience integrating Okta with Liferay , including OIDC-based authentication and user synchronization .
  • Solid background in performance tuning and remediation of technical debt in enterprise portals.
  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git ).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerized environments.
  • English is a requirement, as you will be working directly with US-based clients.
  • Experience working in Linux environments with Tomcat and MySQL is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of REST API integrations and Spring-based services supporting Liferay is a plus.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Lead and support initiatives to address accumulated technical debt, including Liferay DXP upgrades and performance improvements.
  • Implement and maintain identity integrations between Liferay and Okta, migrating authentication flows to OIDC standards.
  • Manage DevOps processes for Liferay DXP deployments, ensuring stable and repeatable releases.
  • Contribute to custom portal development as required by the business.
  • Collaborate in architectural refinement and solution design for scalable, high-traffic environments.
  • Apply agile practices while working independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
  • Participate in documentation efforts throughout the SDLC to ensure platform maintainability and knowledge continuity.


Qualifications

  • Hands-on Liferay DXP experience.
  • Proven Liferay DevOps for upgrades and deployments.
  • Liferay performance tuning.
  • Okta integration experience.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Remote Data Scientist (ML) - 52621
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who has excellent hands on Python skills and Machine Learning experience — someone who lives and breathes code, optimizes for performance, and has proven mastery on competitive programming or data challenge platforms like LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle . In this role you will be working with Turing team members and AI researchers at Frontier Labs to devise techniques and build data sets to improve performance of models.


What You’ll Do:

  • Build, test, and optimize high-performance Python systems used in large-scale AI and data pipelines.
  • Design and maintain modular, clean, and production-ready Python codebases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data, infra, and research engineers) to deliver reliable backend components.
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and testable code with strong focus on algorithms and data structures .
  • Stay current with modern Python tools, frameworks, ML advancements and best practices.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience writing Python in production environments.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and core libraries (Pandas, NumPy, AsyncIO, Pytorch, Transformers, or similar).
  • Proven track record on coding platforms — e.g., top percentile or strong rating on LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle competitions.
  • Experience with system design, clean architecture, and performance optimization.
  • Working level Proficiency in either Machine Learning or Data Science for Machine Learning.


Bonus:

  • Recognized performance in Kaggle , Codeforces , or ICPC/TopCoder contests.
  • Deep curiosity for performance tuning, scalability, and elegant code design.


Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work fully remotely, from anywhere.
  • Collaborate with world-class AI labs and frontier research companies .
  • Tackle real engineering challenges with high autonomy and ownership.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment: Minimum 20 hours/week with 4-hour PST overlap (options: 20, 30, or 40 hrs/week).
  • Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave).
  • Duration: 3 months (start date: next week).


Evaluation Process:

  • Technical Interview (60 mins): discussion of Python problem-solving, architecture, and system design.


After applying, you’ll receive a login link by email. Please complete your profile promptly so we can proceed with your application.


We’re actively hiring for this role. If you know exceptional talent, please refer them at turing.com/referrals and earn money for successful referrals.

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior para atuar em projetos estratégicos, sendo protagonista na construção de soluções técnicas que sustentem decisões baseadas em dados. Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia, tem perfil consultivo e gosta de trabalhar em ambientes colaborativos e dinâmicos, essa vaga é para você!


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis e eficientes em ambientes cloud (Azure).
  • Trabalhar com Databricks para processamento de dados em larga escala, utilizando Spark.
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e segurança dos dados em todas as etapas do processo.
  • Colaborar com times de produto, engenharia e negócios para entender necessidades e traduzir em soluções de dados.
  • Implementar boas práticas de governança, versionamento e documentação de dados.
  • Otimizar performance de pipelines e custos de infraestrutura em cloud.
  • Participar da definição de arquitetura de dados e estratégias de integração entre sistemas.


⚒️ Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com Azure Data Services (Data Lake, Data Factory, Synapse, etc.).
  • Domínio de Databricks e Apache Spark .
  • Proficiência em Python e SQL .
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados, ETL/ELT e arquitetura orientada a dados.
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git) e práticas DevOps para dados.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de orquestração e monitoramento de pipelines.
  • Capacidade analítica, atenção a detalhes e perfil colaborativo.


Desejável

  • Experiência com Delta Lake , Unity Catalog e CI/CD para dados .
  • Conhecimento em Power BI ou outras ferramentas de visualização.
  • Experiência em ambientes ágeis e squads multidisciplinares.
  • Inglês técnico.

title: Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.


Why You Should Apply NOW:

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Pipeline Engineer to join our dynamic Data Engineering team. The ideal candidate possesses 4+ years of data engineering experience. An excellent candidate should have a solid understanding of Spark, SQL, and data pipeline experience. This individual will play a crucial role in supporting our strategic pipelines and optimizing for reliability, efficiency, and performance.

Hired individuals will play a crucial role in helping to shape our ETL strategy and be part of a rapidly growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for researching, planning, and implementing best practices that optimize data pipeline performance and reliability across our organization. You will work cross-functionally with all of our product teams to ensure smooth, efficient, and scalable pipelines. This position is ideal for someone who loves tackling complex technical challenges, enjoys hands-on problem-solving, and loves the fast-paced environment where they can make a big impact.


As Our Data Engineer, You Will:

  • Report directly to the Director of Data Engineering, who will provide significant, hands-on training on cutting-edge data tools and techniques.
  • Build end-to-end data pipelines.
  • Help with setting best practices for our data modeling and pipeline builds.
  • Create documentation, architecture diagrams, and other training materials for analysts.
  • Become an expert at solving complex data pipeline issues using PySpark and SQL.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to incorporate business logic into our central pipelines.
  • Deeply learn Databricks, Airflow, and other ETL tooling.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline.
  • You have 4+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, or in other technical functions.
  • You are comfortable working with large-scale datasets using PySpark or Pandas .
  • You have a great understanding of working with data, orchestration tools, and data pipelines.
  • You understand business needs and the rationale behind different data ingestion and delivery strategies.
  • You are eager to constantly learn new technologies.
  • You are a self-starter who enjoys working with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • You have exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or equivalent.


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Sailpoint Developer
description:
Job Title: SailPoint Developer


Job Location

Remote / Hybrid / Onsite (as applicable)


Experience

6–10+ years overall IAM experience

4–8+ years hands-on SailPoint development


Job Description Summary

We are seeking a SailPoint Developer with strong hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions using SailPoint (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow). The role is focused on custom development, integrations, workflows, and automation , not platform administration or access provisioning support.

The ideal candidate will work closely with security, application, and infrastructure teams to deliver scalable IAM solutions aligned with enterprise security and compliance requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement SailPoint IAM solutions (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow)
  • Develop and customize workflows, rules, connectors, and lifecycle events
  • Build and maintain custom integrations between SailPoint and target systems (REST, SOAP, JDBC, LDAP, AD, Azure AD, etc.)
  • Develop custom provisioning logic , aggregation rules, and identity correlation logic
  • Implement access request, approval, and certification processes
  • Customize SailPoint UI components, forms, and reports as required
  • Develop and maintain policies, roles, entitlements, and governance models
  • Support user lifecycle management (Joiner–Mover–Leaver)
  • Perform unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning of SailPoint solutions
  • Participate in IAM solution design discussions and technical architecture reviews
  • Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer
  • Collaborate with DevOps and security teams for deployments and upgrades
  • Support SailPoint upgrades and migrations (e.g., IIQ versions or IIQ → IdentityNow)


Required Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow
  • Proficiency in Java, BeanShell, JavaScript
  • Experience developing SailPoint rules (Aggregation, Provisioning, Correlation, Validation, Certification)
  • Strong experience with SailPoint workflows
  • Experience with REST/SOAP APIs , JSON, XML
  • Knowledge of IAM concepts : authentication, authorization, RBAC, access governance
  • Experience integrating with:
  • Active Directory / Azure AD
  • LDAP
  • Databases (JDBC)
  • Cloud and enterprise applications
  • Understanding of certifications, access reviews, SoD policies
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • SailPoint certifications (IdentityIQ Engineer, IdentityNow Engineer)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins, CI/CD)
  • Knowledge of security standards (ISO 27001, SOX, GDPR)
  • Experience with PAM integrations (CyberArk, BeyondTrust)
  • Scripting knowledge (Python, PowerShell)


What This Role Is NOT

  • ❌ Not a SailPoint Administrator role
  • ❌ Not limited to user provisioning or access requests
  • ❌ Not a helpdesk or L2/L3 IAM support role


This is a core SailPoint development and engineering role .


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Good communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and with cross-functional teams
  • Security-first mindset

title: Sailpoint Developer
description:
Job Title: SailPoint Developer


Job Location

Remote / Hybrid / Onsite (as applicable)


Experience

6–10+ years overall IAM experience

4–8+ years hands-on SailPoint development


Job Description Summary

We are seeking a SailPoint Developer with strong hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions using SailPoint (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow). The role is focused on custom development, integrations, workflows, and automation , not platform administration or access provisioning support.

The ideal candidate will work closely with security, application, and infrastructure teams to deliver scalable IAM solutions aligned with enterprise security and compliance requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement SailPoint IAM solutions (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow)
  • Develop and customize workflows, rules, connectors, and lifecycle events
  • Build and maintain custom integrations between SailPoint and target systems (REST, SOAP, JDBC, LDAP, AD, Azure AD, etc.)
  • Develop custom provisioning logic , aggregation rules, and identity correlation logic
  • Implement access request, approval, and certification processes
  • Customize SailPoint UI components, forms, and reports as required
  • Develop and maintain policies, roles, entitlements, and governance models
  • Support user lifecycle management (Joiner–Mover–Leaver)
  • Perform unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning of SailPoint solutions
  • Participate in IAM solution design discussions and technical architecture reviews
  • Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer
  • Collaborate with DevOps and security teams for deployments and upgrades
  • Support SailPoint upgrades and migrations (e.g., IIQ versions or IIQ → IdentityNow)


Required Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow
  • Proficiency in Java, BeanShell, JavaScript
  • Experience developing SailPoint rules (Aggregation, Provisioning, Correlation, Validation, Certification)
  • Strong experience with SailPoint workflows
  • Experience with REST/SOAP APIs , JSON, XML
  • Knowledge of IAM concepts : authentication, authorization, RBAC, access governance
  • Experience integrating with:
  • Active Directory / Azure AD
  • LDAP
  • Databases (JDBC)
  • Cloud and enterprise applications
  • Understanding of certifications, access reviews, SoD policies
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • SailPoint certifications (IdentityIQ Engineer, IdentityNow Engineer)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins, CI/CD)
  • Knowledge of security standards (ISO 27001, SOX, GDPR)
  • Experience with PAM integrations (CyberArk, BeyondTrust)
  • Scripting knowledge (Python, PowerShell)


What This Role Is NOT

  • ❌ Not a SailPoint Administrator role
  • ❌ Not limited to user provisioning or access requests
  • ❌ Not a helpdesk or L2/L3 IAM support role


This is a core SailPoint development and engineering role .


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Good communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and with cross-functional teams
  • Security-first mindset

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SalesForce
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Oportunidade para: Desenvolvedor(a) SalesForce Sênior


Experiência sólida (nível sênior) em projetos Salesforce, atuando como desenvolvedor(a) por no mínimo 4 anos (ou equivalente).


Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e em squads multidisciplinares.

Experiência prática com integrações complexas e grandes volumes de dados


Desejável experiência em projetos de implementação de soluções escaláveis em empresas de médio e grande porte.

Desenvolver soluções customizadas na plataforma Salesforce utilizando Apex, LWC (Lightning Web Components), Visualforce e triggers.


Implementar integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST/SOAP.

Criar automações avançadas, componentes reutilizáveis e testes unitários com alta cobertura.

Otimizar queries e gerenciar limites da plataforma (governor limits).

Colaborar com times funcionais e administradores para entrega de soluções técnicas aderentes aos requisitos de negócio.

Apoiar a gestão do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento (DevOps), incluindo controle de versões e deploys com ferramentas como SFDX, Git e pipelines de CI/CD.


certificações Salesforce.


Modelo de trabalho:

100% remoto e CLT e PJ


Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Viral video content creator
description:
Looking for a Viral Video Scriptwriter + Editor who can consistently create viral-style performance video ads using AI tools at scale. You will own the output like it’s your channel, not a “tasks” role.

We run performance marketing campaigns and need a steady pipeline of fresh, high-converting video creatives for the US consumer.

Mission for this job

Own the end-to-end creative pipeline for short-form video ads:

  • Research the market and audience
  • Write scripts that hook hard and hold attention
  • Edit fast, clean videos using AI + simple editing tools
  • Ship volume, learn from results, and iterate daily
What success looks likeFirst 30 days
  • Learn our offers, compliance guardrails, and what “good” looks like for us.
  • Deliver a consistent daily output of scripts + edited videos (with clear naming and organization).
  • Build a repeatable workflow using AI tools for speed (script, voice, visuals, editing, captions).
  • Show you can research the US consumer and write in natural, native-sounding English.
By 90 days
  • Ship a reliable volume of creatives every week with clear variation by hook, angle, and structure.
  • Consistently produce multiple “winners” per month (videos we can scale spend behind).
  • Maintain a simple testing system: what you tried, what worked, what failed, and what to do next.
  • Become independent: you don’t wait for perfect direction to move.
By 12 months
  • Fully own a creative machine that feeds our ad accounts nonstop.
  • Have a documented system another creator could follow.
  • Be the go-to person for viral ad formats, hooks, and creative strategy across offers.
What you will do
  • Write short-form ad scripts (UGC style, narration, simple scenes, strong hooks).
  • Do research (audience pains, language, objections, comments, competitor ads).
  • Edit videos in CapCut (or similar) and ship finished assets ready to launch.
  • Use AI tools to generate footage, b-roll, voice, captions, and variations fast.
  • Create lots of iterations: new hooks, new openings, new pacing, new visuals.
  • Organize deliverables cleanly (folders, versions, naming, notes).
Who you are
  • You have a portfolio of viral videos, ad creatives, or short-form edits.
  • You have strong English and can write like a real US consumer talks.
  • You understand basic copywriting: hook, problem, proof, offer, CTA.
  • You can edit quickly in CapCut (or similar) and keep pacing tight.
  • You’ve used AI tools to create videos at scale (not just one-offs).
  • You move fast, learn fast, and you care more about output and results than comfort.


Core values

Resourcefulness – You figure things out with minimal help.

Perfectly acceptable over perfection – Ship fast, then improve.

Constructive disagreement – Challenge ideas to get to the truth.

Kind, not nice – Honest feedback that helps people win long term.

Growth mindset – Learn from misses, don’t repeat mistakes.

Full ownership – Act like the outcome is on you.


Offer

Competitive pay + profit share based on skill and output, with clear growth as you produce consistent winners.

Apply

Email

with:

  • Your portfolio (required if you have it)
  • A short note on your AI + editing workflow
  • 2–3 examples you’re most proud of and why they worked

If you don’t have a portfolio but you’re sure you can win in this role, email anyway and explain your background plus how you’ll prove yourself fast.

title: Viral video content creator
description:
Looking for a Viral Video Scriptwriter + Editor who can consistently create viral-style performance video ads using AI tools at scale. You will own the output like it’s your channel, not a “tasks” role.

We run performance marketing campaigns and need a steady pipeline of fresh, high-converting video creatives for the US consumer.

Mission for this job

Own the end-to-end creative pipeline for short-form video ads:

  • Research the market and audience
  • Write scripts that hook hard and hold attention
  • Edit fast, clean videos using AI + simple editing tools
  • Ship volume, learn from results, and iterate daily
What success looks likeFirst 30 days
  • Learn our offers, compliance guardrails, and what “good” looks like for us.
  • Deliver a consistent daily output of scripts + edited videos (with clear naming and organization).
  • Build a repeatable workflow using AI tools for speed (script, voice, visuals, editing, captions).
  • Show you can research the US consumer and write in natural, native-sounding English.
By 90 days
  • Ship a reliable volume of creatives every week with clear variation by hook, angle, and structure.
  • Consistently produce multiple “winners” per month (videos we can scale spend behind).
  • Maintain a simple testing system: what you tried, what worked, what failed, and what to do next.
  • Become independent: you don’t wait for perfect direction to move.
By 12 months
  • Fully own a creative machine that feeds our ad accounts nonstop.
  • Have a documented system another creator could follow.
  • Be the go-to person for viral ad formats, hooks, and creative strategy across offers.
What you will do
  • Write short-form ad scripts (UGC style, narration, simple scenes, strong hooks).
  • Do research (audience pains, language, objections, comments, competitor ads).
  • Edit videos in CapCut (or similar) and ship finished assets ready to launch.
  • Use AI tools to generate footage, b-roll, voice, captions, and variations fast.
  • Create lots of iterations: new hooks, new openings, new pacing, new visuals.
  • Organize deliverables cleanly (folders, versions, naming, notes).
Who you are
  • You have a portfolio of viral videos, ad creatives, or short-form edits.
  • You have strong English and can write like a real US consumer talks.
  • You understand basic copywriting: hook, problem, proof, offer, CTA.
  • You can edit quickly in CapCut (or similar) and keep pacing tight.
  • You’ve used AI tools to create videos at scale (not just one-offs).
  • You move fast, learn fast, and you care more about output and results than comfort.


Core values

Resourcefulness – You figure things out with minimal help.

Perfectly acceptable over perfection – Ship fast, then improve.

Constructive disagreement – Challenge ideas to get to the truth.

Kind, not nice – Honest feedback that helps people win long term.

Growth mindset – Learn from misses, don’t repeat mistakes.

Full ownership – Act like the outcome is on you.


Offer

Competitive pay + profit share based on skill and output, with clear growth as you produce consistent winners.

Apply

Email

with:

  • Your portfolio (required if you have it)
  • A short note on your AI + editing workflow
  • 2–3 examples you’re most proud of and why they worked

If you don’t have a portfolio but you’re sure you can win in this role, email anyway and explain your background plus how you’ll prove yourself fast.

title: Recrutador executivo
description:
Executive Recruiter (Fluent English – C1/C2) | 100% Remote | US Market


A Blue Dot BPO conecta talentos estratégicos da América Latina a operações críticas de empresas norte-americanas. Estamos expandindo nossa atuação e buscamos um(a) Executive Recruiter para conduzir processos executivos de alto impacto , atuando diretamente com lideranças sêniores dos Estados Unidos.

Esta é uma posição 100% remota , com alto grau de autonomia, exposição internacional e responsabilidade ponta a ponta nos processos de recrutamento.


O que oferecemos

  • Remuneração fixa mensal de R$ 5.000 , com bônus adicionais em dólares
  • Trabalho remoto integral (segunda a sexta, 13h às 22h BRT )
  • Contrato de longo prazo e oportunidades reais de crescimento
  • Atuação estratégica junto a executivos e times C-level nos EUA
  • Ambiente multicultural, orientado a performance, processos e meritocracia


Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir recrutamento full-cycle para posições executivas
  • Desenvolver sourcing avançado e mapeamento de mercado
  • Realizar entrevistas estruturadas e pré-qualificação profunda
  • Gerenciar pipelines estratégicos e relacionamento com stakeholders
  • Coordenar entrevistas com equipes norte-americanas
  • Garantir excelência operacional em ATS e dados de recrutamento


O que buscamos

  • 2+ anos de experiência em recrutamento executivo/hunting
  • Inglês fluente (C1/C2 ) para interação diária
  • Perfil hunter, analítico e orientado a resultados
  • Domínio de LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS e job boards
  • Comunicação sólida, postura consultiva e alto nível de organização


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em executive recruiting de ciclo completo.
  • Familiaridade com práticas e mercado de recrutamento norte-americano.



Requisitos técnicos

  • Notebook com processador i7 (ou equivalente) e 12GB+ RAM .
  • Dois monitores para rotina operacional.
  • Internet de alta velocidade.
  • Headset profissional.
  • Ambiente silencioso e estruturado para trabalho remoto.


Construa sua carreira internacional!


Se você deseja atuar diretamente com o mercado dos EUA, desenvolver experiência executiva e crescer em um ambiente orientado a alta performance, evolução contínua e consistência, esta oportunidade é para você. Candidate-se e faça parte da Blue Dot BPO

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Role -LLM - Full Stack Python + JS

Project duration: 3 Months

Exp - 3+ Years

Skill - Python, JavaScript / Node.js, TypeScript

Availability - 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.


Role Overview :

We’re a coding-focused team at Turing that serves as a research partner for a Frontier AI Lab. Our role is to build coding tasks, evaluations, datasets, and tooling that help train and improve large language models (LLMs).

You’ll write and debug production-quality code, design rigorous evaluations, and build reproducible workflows that generate clean, high-signal data for model training. Attention to detail matters deeply here—small mistakes can cascade into misleading results, so precision and thoroughness are essential. You’ll also collaborate closely with engineers, researchers, and quality owners to align on standards, review work, and continuously raise the quality bar.

If you enjoy solving unusual technical problems, investigating subtle model failures, and working in developer-like environments where correctness, reproducibility, and collaboration matter, this role will keep you very entertained.


What does your day-to-day look like :

  • Write, review, and debug code across multiple languages
  • Design tasks and evaluation scenarios for coding, reasoning, and debugging
  • Investigate LLM outputs and identify hallucinations, regressions, and failure modes
  • Build reproducible dev environments using Docker + automation tools
  • Develop scripts, pipelines, and tools for data generation, scoring, and validation
  • Produce structured annotations, judgments, and high-quality datasets
  • Run systematic evaluations that help improve model reliability and reasoning

Required Skills :

  • Experience using LLM coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, CodeWhisperer)Strong hands-on coding experience (professional or research-based) in one or more of:
  • Python, JavaScript / Node.js, TypeScript
  • (Additional languages like Go, Java, C++, C#, Rust, SQL, R, Dart, etc. are a plus)
  • Solid experience with Linux + Bash, scripting, and automation
  • Strong with Docker, reproducible environments, and dev containers
  • Advanced Git skills (branching, diffs, patches, conflict resolution)
  • Solid understanding of testing and QA (unit, integration, negative, edge-case focused)
  • Ability to reliably overlap with 8am–12pm PT

title: Analista de Segurança Digital
description:
Sobre a ZenoX

A ZenoX é uma empresa brasileira de cibersegurança especializada em Threat Intelligence. Nossa plataforma Vydar monitora e protege marcas e ativos digitais de nossos clientes contra fraudes, vazamentos de dados, phishing e ameaças cibernéticas. Combinamos tecnologia de ponta com inteligência artificial (Tellyu) para detectar e responder a ameaças de forma ágil e eficiente.


Sobre a Posição

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Segurança Digital para atuar na operação da plataforma Vydar, nossa plataforma de Threat Intelligence, sendo responsável pela análise e validação de incidentes críticos direcionadas aos nossos clientes. Este profissional terá papel fundamental na qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades

• Detectar e classificar ameaças direcionadas aos clientes utilizando a plataforma Vydar da ZenoX e ferramentas complementares;

• Conduzir investigações de fraudes, golpes e incidentes de nível 1;

• Realizar engajamento com atores de ameaças para coleta de inteligência e contextualização;

• Monitorar e reportar novas fontes de vazamentos para ampliar a cobertura de monitoramento;

• Apoiar na revisão e ajuste de Casos de Uso na plataforma, garantindo precisão e conformidade com os contratos;

• Analisar KPIs de qualidade dos Tenants, como volume de ameaças;

• Comunicar descobertas e alertas críticos ao time de Customer Success;

• Documentar análises e alimentar a base de conhecimento da organização;

• Executar rotinas operacionais e playbooks diários.


Requisitos

• Experiência em análise de ameaças cibernéticas, fraudes digitais ou segurança da informação;

• Familiaridade com plataformas de Threat Intelligence ou Digital Risk Protection;

• Capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes para validação de alertas;

• Boa comunicação escrita para documentação e relatórios;

• Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia;

• Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação e análise de fontes internacionais.


Diferenciais

• Conhecimento em OSINT (Open Source Intelligence) e técnicas de investigação digital;

• Vivência em operação de SOC ou equipes de resposta a incidentes;

• Familiaridade com Dark Web e Deep Web para monitoramento de ameaças;

• Experiência com automações e scripts para análise de dados;

• Conhecimento em monitoramento de marca, phishing, vazamento de dados e/ou fraudes online.


O Que Oferecemos

• Contato direto com tecnologias de IA aplicadas à segurança;

• Treinamentos contínuos e possibilidade de certificações na área;

• Trabalho remoto.


Modelo de Contratação

• Contratação: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)

• Modalidade: Remoto

title: Closer de vendas
description:
Resumo da vaga


Estamos em busca de um Closer de Vendas para atuar 100% de forma remota, com foco no fechamento de produtos e serviços digitais de uma marca consolidada no mercado digital.


Essa vaga é destinada a profissionais de vendas que já possuem experiência com marcas digitais, conhecem o ambiente online e desejam atuar em um ecossistema em expansão, com estrutura, processos claros e visão de crescimento de longo prazo.



Sobre o Ecossistema FastFood Milionário


O Ecossistema FastFood Milionário atua no mercado de educação, consultoria e treinamento, oferecendo soluções digitais estratégicas para negócios do ramo alimentício.


Somos uma marca digital estruturada, com audiência qualificada, produtos validados e presença consolidada no mercado. Estamos em fase de expansão e fortalecimento da área comercial, buscando profissionais que queiram crescer junto com o ecossistema e fazer parte de um projeto sólido e em constante evolução.



Responsabilidades


* ⁠Conduzir reuniões de vendas 100% online com potenciais clientes

• Realizar o fechamento de contratos de produtos e serviços digitais

• Atuar de forma consultiva, entendendo o cenário e a necessidade do cliente

• Seguir scripts, processos e metodologia comercial definidos

• Registrar e acompanhar negociações por meio de CRM

• Trabalhar com metas e indicadores de performance



Requisitos obrigatórios

• Experiência comprovada em vendas de marcas digitais

• Vivência com produtos digitais, mentorias, consultorias ou serviços online

• Experiência prévia como Closer de Vendas ou vendedor consultivo

• Boa comunicação, postura profissional e clareza na condução das reuniões

• Familiaridade com vendas 100% online e trabalho remoto




Diferenciais

• Experiência com vendas high ticket

• Vivência em lançamentos, perpétuo ou vendas inbound

• Experiência com CRM e processos comerciais estruturados




O que oferecemos

• Trabalho 100% remoto, com atuação totalmente online

• Salário fixo + comissão por vendas

• Bonificação por performance, vinculada a metas e resultados

• Atuação em uma marca digital consolidada

• Plano de crescimento dentro do Ecossistema FastFood Milionário, com possibilidade real de evolução profissional e financeira

• Participação em um projeto em fase de expansão, com visão de longo prazo



Considerações finais


Esta vaga é voltada para profissionais que levam vendas a sério, já atuam no mercado digital e buscam fazer parte de um ecossistema estruturado, em crescimento contínuo e com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento de carreira.

title: Cientista de Dados Senior (IA)
description:
Descrição do cargo

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior AI / ML Engineer para liderar o desenvolvimento e a implantação de soluções de Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning em escala. Essa pessoa será protagonista na construção do nosso ecossistema de IA, atuando com GenAI, NLP, visão computacional, entre outros, com impacto direto em produtos, processos e decisões estratégicas da empresa.

Propósito da posição


Você será responsável por transformar dados em decisões inteligentes, liderando frentes técnicas e estratégicas com foco em inovação, eficiência e impacto real no negócio.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos, integrações e fundações de ciência de dados e IA, trabalhando em colaboração com áreas envolvidas.
  • Propor, construir e acompanhar soluções fim a fim: desde o mapeamento da necessidade, proposição e desenho de solução, exploração do dados, treinamento, produtização e escala do modelo, análise e monitoramento dos seus resultados, além do acompanhamento do seu ciclo e consumo, garantindo pontos de condução ética e legal.
  • Evoluir o ecossistema de Data & AI para que esteja saudável, atualizado e à frente do mercado, com construção conjunta com áreas parceiras como Arquiteturas, Engenharias de Aplicações, Sustentação, Negócios e Riscos.
  • Estabelecer, guiar e avaliar melhores prática, capabilities, engines, aceleradores, padrões e frameworks em cases e soluções técnicas,
  • Avaliar, aplicar e disseminar boas práticas de governança, ética, justiça, explicabilidade, segurança e compliance em modelos de IA.
  • Conduzir e estabelecendo um grande Centro de Excelência habilitador de jornada com responsabilidade.
  • Criar parcerias e manter proximidade com Big Techs, alianças e universidades criando programas e laboratórios como parte evolutiva do ecossistema.
  • Colaborar ativamente com Data Strategy alinhada ao Business Strategy e tendências de mercado, construindo a visão de business x technical capabilities.
  • Contribuir em frentes culturais com o propósito de educar, capacitar, conscientizar, além de elevar o nível de maturidade em dados e IA na organização


Técnicas

  • Desenvolver e operacionalizar modelos de IA e ML em ambientes de produção.
  • Criar e manter pipelines de dados e ML com foco em escalabilidade e governança.
  • Atuar com modelos supervisionados, não supervisionados, GenAI, NLP, LLMs e sistemas de recomendação.
  • Monitorar e ajustar modelos em produção para garantir performance e acurácia.

Estratégicas e culturais

  • Liderar iniciativas técnicas e contribuir para a visão de IA na companhia.
  • Disseminar boas práticas de IA responsável (fairness, explicabilidade, compliance).
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com arquitetura, produto, dados e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar a formação de um CoE de IA e promover a maturidade analítica da organização.
  • Conectar a estratégia de dados com a estratégia de negócio.

Stack técnica

  • Linguagens: Python (obrigatório), SQL
  • Bibliotecas: Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Transformers (Hugging Face), OpenAI, Llama LLM
  • MLOps: MLflow, DVC, Airflow, CI/CD

Plataformas: Databricks, Azure (preferencial), AWS ou GCP

  • Bancos: Delta Lake, SQL, NoSQL
  • Ferramentas de visualização: Power BI


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Inglês avançado
  • 5+ anos de experiência com ciência de dados e IA em produção
  • Proficiência em Python e bibliotecas de ML/IA
  • Experiência com MLOps, deploy de modelos e monitoramento
  • Conhecimento em modelos generativos (LLMs, embeddings & orchestration, prompt engineering)
  • Experiência com pipelines em cloud (preferencialmente Azure/Databricks)
  • Forte capacidade analítica e habilidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções técnicas
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa e gerenciar múltiplas prioridades.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de referência de governança de IA (envolvendo pontos como Responsible AI, AI Fairness).

Diferenciais

  • Compartilhar o GitHub ou qualquer outro repositório de portfolio para conhecermos seu trabalho
  • Experiência com time series, recomendação e modelos de visão computacional
  • Atuação prévia em CoEs ou iniciativas de IA Corporativa
  • Pós-graduação, certificações ou publicações relevantes

Se você quer trabalhar com IA de verdade, com liberdade para inovar e gerar impacto, essa vaga é pra você!!!

title: Business Development Representative (BDR) – Offshore
description:
Role Overview

The Business Development Representative (BDR) is responsible for generating qualified sales conversations and pipeline for Exelegent’s 2026 growth objectives.

This role combines inbound lead qualification and active outbound prospecting, ensuring pipeline continuity even during periods of low inbound demand.

The BDR is accountable for pipeline flow, not for waiting on leads.


Key Responsibilities

Pipeline & Prospecting

• Actively generate new sales opportunities through outbound prospecting when inbound lead volume is insufficient

• Execute cold outreach via email, LinkedIn, and approved outbound tools

• Proactively identify and engage target accounts and decision-makers

• Support Account-Based Marketing (ABM) initiatives with targeted outreach

Lead Qualification

• Qualify inbound leads according to ICP and SQL definitions

• Validate decision-maker authority, business need, and timing

• Schedule qualified meetings for the sales team

Collaboration & Process

• Work closely with Marketing to align messaging, targeting, and campaigns

• Collaborate with Sales to ensure smooth handoff and feedback loops

• Maintain accurate CRM records and pipeline hygiene

• Follow defined outreach sequences and qualification standards


Success Metrics

• Number of qualified SQLs generated per month (inbound + outbound)

• Consistency of pipeline flow regardless of inbound volume

• Meeting-to-opportunity conversion rate

• Pipeline value influenced or created

• Accuracy and completeness of CRM data


Required Qualifications

• 1–3 years of experience in outbound sales or business development (B2B)

• Proven experience with cold email and LinkedIn prospecting

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

• Ability to work with structured ICP and qualification frameworks

• Comfortable operating in a performance-driven, remote environment


Preferred Qualifications

• Experience selling B2B services, technology, or SaaS

• Familiarity with outbound and CRM tools (e.g., Apollo, Instantly, LinkedIn Sales Navigator)

• Exposure to mid-market or enterprise sales motions

• Experience supporting ABM or targeted account strategies


Working Style & Expectations

• Proactive and self-directed

• Comfortable switching between inbound qualification and outbound prospecting

• Results-oriented, not activity-driven

• Strong discipline in follow-ups and documentation


Why Join Exelegent

• Clear expectations and measurable impact on revenue

• Opportunity to work with enterprise and mid-market accounts

• Structured processes combined with autonomy

• Direct contribution to pipeline and growth initiatives

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Power Automate
description:
VAGA ABERTA: Desenvolvedor(a) Power Automate Sênior – Remoto


Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com 28 anos de experiência e reconhecidos pelo GPTW pelo quinto ano consecutivo, estamos em busca de talentos para se juntarem a nós como Desenvolvedor(a) Power Automate . Com matriz no Brasil e filiais em território internacional, oferecemos oportunidades para crescimento e desenvolvimento. Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!


Requisitos essenciais:


  • Atuação remota, com disponibilidade para comparecimento presencial eventual no Rio de Janeiro, caso o profissional esteja na cidade;
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com Microsoft Power Automate (Cloud e Desktop);
  • Domínio na criação de fluxos instantâneos, agendados e automatizados, incluindo uso de conectores e integrações com APIs, bancos de dados, SharePoint e Teams;
  • Proficiência no uso de Power Apps e Dataverse ou SQL Server;
  • Portfólio comprovado de automações com ganhos mensuráveis de produtividade e economia de tempo;
  • Habilidade para interagir, alinhar expectativas e negociar diretamente com clientes;
  • Formação superior completa em TI, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento sólido em governança e boas práticas do Power Platform.


Requisitos adicionais:


  • Experiência em integrações com Jira ou Azure DevOps;
  • Certificações Microsoft PL-400 (Power Platform Developer) ou PL-200 (Functional Consultant);
  • Conhecimento em Power BI, Power Virtual Agents e Azure Logic Apps ou Azure Functions;
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis, como Scrum ou Kanban, e práticas de DevOps com Azure DevOps Pipelines;
  • Experiência prévia em mentoring ou liderança técnica de equipes;
  • Atuação anterior em projetos do setor de Telecom ou em consultorias;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, plataformas de geração de imagens ou automação de processos, aplicadas a: Automatização de tarefas, criação de relatórios e análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão e inovação contínua, melhoria da eficiência operacional e qualidade das entregas.

title: Senior Project Manager (Software Development)
description:
For Brazil Only, PJ contract, Fluent English


Job Title: Senior Project Manager (Software Development)


Type: Full-Time


About Indigo Beam

Indigo Beam is a digital transformation consulting firm dedicated to helping organizations evolve their business through modern technology solutions. We partner with our clients to improve customer experience, reengineer operational workflows, modernize legacy systems, and unlock data-driven insights that power smarter decision-making. Our services span Content Management, ERP, Digital Modernization, GIS & BI, CRM, and AI—helping businesses not just react to change, but lead it.


Key Responsibilities:

Leadership & Team Management:

  • Lead and manage cross-functional teams, including Technical Architects, Developers, QA, and Business Analysts, ensuring high performance and alignment with project goals.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Oversee the team's daily operations, ensuring tasks are completed on time and within scope.


Project Management:

  • Develop, maintain, and execute detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, with a focus on application/software development.
  • Own and facilitate project status meetings, adjusting project targets and schedules as needed.


Microsoft DevOps Project Management:

  • Manage and configure sprints, backlogs, and work items within Microsoft DevOps to ensure project transparency and alignment with Agile methodologies.
  • Track and manage user stories and epics, ensuring they are well-defined, prioritized, and aligned with project goals.
  • Facilitate daily stand-ups (scrums), sprint planning, and sprint retrospectives to ensure team collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Monitor and manage burndown charts and other Agile metrics to track project progress and ensure timely delivery.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure DevOps practices support efficient project execution and align with client needs.


Business Analysis:

  • Perform business analysis tasks on projects as needed, including requirements gathering, process mapping, and stakeholder interviews.
  • Ensure business requirements are clearly defined, documented, and communicated to technical teams.


Client Engagement:

  • Serve as clients' primary point of contact, ensuring their needs and expectations are met.
  • Communicate project progress, risks, and issues effectively to clients and stakeholders.
  • Ensure client satisfaction by delivering projects that meet or exceed their requirements.


Technical Oversight:

  • Collaborate with Technical Architects to ensure project designs align with business objectives and technical standards.
  • Review and approve technical and business documentation, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies to provide strategic technical direction.


Quality Assurance & Risk Management:

  • Implement quality control processes to ensure deliverables meet the required standards.
  • Identify and mitigate project risks, ensuring proactive solutions to potential challenges.


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Fluent English
  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a closely related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of IT Project Management experience in an Agile (Scrum) environment, with a strong focus on application/software development.
  • Prior hands-on development or coding experience.
  • Proven track record of managing teams of Technical Architects, Developers, QA professionals, and Business Analysts.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft DevOps, particularly in managing user stories, epics, sprints, and Agile metrics such as burndown charts.
  • Ability to perform business analysis on projects, including requirements gathering and process documentation.
  • Experience managing project budgets of over $1M and delivering projects on time and within scope.
  • Hands-on experience overseeing all phases of the SDLC, from requirements gathering to deployment.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills, with a proven ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organization skills and mindset.


Desired Skills & Qualifications:

  • Experience in the Oil and Gas industry is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience in a consulting role or possessing a consultative mindset.
  • PMP certification and CSM.


Other:

  • The role offers a dynamic work environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies and solutions.
  • The successful candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.


Informations:

  • Type of Contract: PJ
  • Hours: Full-time
  • Location: 100% Remote
  • Start Date: Immediate
  • Duration: Long-term

  • Ability to perform business analysis on projects, including requirements gathering and process documentation.
  • Experience managing project budgets of over $1M and delivering projects on time and within scope.
  • Hands-on experience overseeing all phases of the SDLC, from requirements gathering to deployment.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills, with a proven ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organization skills and mindset.


Desired Skills & Qualifications:

  • Experience in the Oil and Gas industry is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience in a consulting role or possessing a consultative mindset.
  • PMP certification and CSM.


Other:

  • The role offers a dynamic work environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies and solutions.
  • The successful candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.


Informations:

  • Type of Contract: PJ
  • Hours: Full-time
  • Location: 100% Remote
  • Start Date: Immediate
  • Duration: Long-term

title: SDR Hunter de Influenciadores Gamers
description:
A NoPing é uma plataforma de melhoria de conexão e performance para gamers, focada em reduzir ping, packet loss e aumentar FPS em jogos online.

Estamos montando um time comercial de alta performance para expandir nossa base de influenciadores ao redor do mundo.


Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como *SDR Hunter*, focada em prospecção, qualificação e primeiro contato com streamers, criadores de conteúdo e parceiros estratégicos.

Se você vive o universo gamer, gosta de falar com pessoas e tem inglês fluente, essa vaga é para você.


*Responsabilidades*


* Prospectar novos influenciadores, afiliados e parceiros em múltiplas plataformas

* Realizar o primeiro contato com creators: e mail, DM em redes sociais, Discord, etc

* Qualificar influenciadores de acordo com critérios definidos pela NoPing

* Explicar de forma clara o que é o NoPing e como o criador pode ganhar dinheiro com a parceria

* Fechar novas parcerias seguindo metas semanais de volume e qualidade

* Garantir o onboarding inicial do influenciador, enviando materiais, scripts e orientações de divulgação

* Registrar todas as interações e status no CRM de forma organizada

* Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas de Marketing, Parcerias e Sucesso de Influenciadores

* Acompanhar métricas de prospecção, conversão e performance dos influenciadores trazidos

title: Data Analyst
description:
We're looking for a Data Analytics & Engineering Specialist in Brazil!!


Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ - Open Ended


About the Role

We are looking for a gritty problem solver and self-starter who will serve as a key interface between the Analytics and Engineering teams. In this role, you will deeply understand the needs of analytics stakeholders, anticipate future requirements, and partner closely with Data Engineers to identify, vet, and prioritize upstream data. Your mission is to enable strong analytical capabilities, drive operational excellence, and improve efficiency across data partnerships.


What You’ll Do

  • Rationalize and prioritize data requests, designing ideal and scalable solutions.
  • Execute new data flows and maintain existing pipelines on a daily basis.
  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, efficient data pipelines that support multiple use cases with minimal incremental effort.
  • Drive the vision for Business Intelligence (BI) and Data Warehousing across all business lines, defining and executing a roadmap to achieve that vision.
  • Evolve analytical data ecosystems to support advanced analytics and big data use cases.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in analytics and data engineering.
  • 1+ year of hands-on experience with big data processing systems such as Hadoop, Hive, Spark, or similar technologies.
  • Expert-level proficiency in SQL.
  • Proven ability to design and lead time-sensitive, strategic projects involving methodology development, analysis, and presentation of insights and recommendations.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree in a STEM field (Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related area).
  • Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as MicroStrategy, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with Unix/Linux shell scripting and Python.
  • Strong database performance tuning and optimization skills.


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, mathematics, or related field preferred.

title: Pessoa DevOps Engineer
description:
Sobre a Duotalk:


Somos uma empresa de tecnologia que desenvolve uma plataforma de atendimento omnichannel com inteligência artificial, ajudando equipes de marketing e vendas a vender mais e atender melhor nos canais conversacionais, como WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger e webchat. 


Descrição da vaga:


Se você é apaixonado por automação, infraestrutura como código e deseja trabalhar em um time ágil, ajudando a criar soluções escaláveis e resilientes, essa vaga é para você! Buscamos um DevOps Engineer para otimizar, monitorar e escalar nossas aplicações em um ambiente de alta disponibilidade.


Responsabilidades:


 ✅ Criar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para garantir a entrega contínua de software

 ✅ Monitorar, criar alertas e otimizar a performance da infraestrutura, garantindo alta disponibilidade

 ✅ Automatizar processos operacionais e de deployment

 ✅ Garantir a segurança da infraestrutura e das aplicações

 ✅ Trabalhar com conteinerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes)

 ✅ Implementar e gerenciar ferramentas de observabilidade e logging

 ✅ Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento para melhorar a confiabilidade e a escalabilidade das aplicações


Requisitos:


  Experiência com Kubernetes e Docker

  Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (Karpenter, Helm, Terraform, Ansible, etc.)

  Experiência com AWS (EKS, CloudWatch, SNS, ECS, Lambda, IAM)

  Domínio de pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines.)

  Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch, Datadog)

  Conhecimento em segurança de infraestrutura e DevSecOps (AWS Network Firewall borda externa e interna, docker scout e outras ferramentas de segurança)

  Boa capacidade de troubleshooting e resolução de problemas

  Práticas de post mortem com incidentes


Diferenciais:


 ⭐ Experiência com Serverless

 ⭐ Conhecimento em Istio e circuit breakers

 ⭐ Conhecimento em redes e segurança avançada

 ⭐ Experiência em ambientes de microsserviços

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Desenvolvedor/a SR Golang / PHP (PJ | Remoto)
description:
Contratação PJ

Atuação 100% remota


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Analista/Desenvolvedora de software para compor o nosso time. Somos responsáveis pelos processos de gestão de rotas logísticas, transportadoras, calendários de coleta e expedição de produtos e operações dentro de nossos centros de distribuição, acompanhando a experiência dos nossos clientes desde o processo de cotação dos produtos até o recebimento destes em suas casas.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver APIs, ferramentas visuais e automações para facilitar e simplificar a experiência do time de operações na gestão dos seus processos.
  • Atuar com inovação, simplificação de processos e escalabilidade, aplicando boas práticas de arquitetura de software.
  • Contribuir com os desafios do seu time e de todo o time de desenvolvimento, compartilhando ideias, soluções e códigos.
  • Desenvolver e manter os sistemas sob responsabilidade do time.
  • Atender às demandas priorizadas para o time.
  • Entender e resolver problemas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time para apoiar nas melhores soluções.
  • Participar das reuniões e cerimônias do time.
  • Colaborar com a liderança.
  • Compartilhar dúvidas e desafios do dia a dia com o time.
  • Organizar suas atividades considerando maior prioridade e impacto no cliente.


Competências Técnicas/Soft Skills:

  • Conhecimento e experiência em Golang e PHP .
  • Conhecimento em Banco de Dados relacionais como MySQL.
  • Conhecimento em Bancos não relacionais como Mongo, Redis, Memcached.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas AWS como S3, SQS, SNS, EC2 e ECS (ou outros serviços Cloud).
  • Conhecimento em Microsserviços.
  • Atuação com arquitetura orientada a eventos (Kakfa, RabbitM&Q)



Formação:

  • Superior cursando ou completo e uma vontade GIGANTE de aprender/ensinar a todo momento!


Diferenciais:

  • Atuação FullStack com React no frontend;
  • Experiência com Node e Python ;
  • Conhecimento em Automação de testes.

title: Gerente de projetos SAP sênior
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Projetos Sênior para liderar iniciativas estratégicas de migração SAP ECC → S/4HANA, assumindo papel-chave na transformação digital da organização. Este(a) profissional será responsável por conduzir projetos de alta complexidade, garantindo a integração entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, o alinhamento com a estratégia corporativa e a entrega de resultados com qualidade, prazo e custo controlados.

É essencial que o candidato possua conhecimento técnico do ecossistema SAP, permitindo compreender impactos funcionais e tecnológicos, dialogar com equipes de migração de dados, Basis, funcionais (FI/MM/SD/BP) e arquitetos de soluções, além de garantir aderência às melhores práticas e metodologias de migração.


Atividades

  • Planejar, coordenar e liderar projetos de migração de alta complexidade no ecossistema SAP.
  • Atuar de forma próxima às equipes técnicas e funcionais, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em planos de execução viáveis.
  • Elaborar, controlar e atualizar cronograma, escopo, orçamento e plano de comunicação do projeto.
  • Planejar e supervisionar as estratégias de migração de dados, desde inventário, mapeamento, saneamento até cargas e validações finais.
  • Coordenar ciclos de conversão, testes integrados (SIT/UAT), cutover e estabilização pós-go live.
  • Identificar, monitorar e mitigar riscos e impactos de mudanças de escopo, assegurando compliance com premissas e restrições.
  • Gerenciar stakeholders internos e externos, promovendo alinhamento e comunicação executiva clara.
  • Garantir que o projeto seja executado dentro dos prazos, custos e qualidade definidos, reportando status para comitês e diretoria.
  • Produzir e consolidar documentações de acompanhamento, lições aprendidas e relatórios executivos.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Superior completo em TI, Engenharias, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em gestão de projetos complexos, com ênfase em migração SAP ECC → SAP S/4HANA.
  • Conhecimento técnico do ecossistema SAP, incluindo módulos principais (FI, MM, SD, BP) e integração com áreas funcionais.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas e metodologias de migração SAP (SAP Migration Cockpit, LSMW, SAP Data Services, BW/4HANA Transfer Cockpit).
  • Domínio da metodologia SAP Activate, incluindo suas fases (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run).
  • Conhecimento aprofundado das estratégias de conversão: Brownfield, Greenfield e Bluefield.
  • Experiência em SAP ECC, incluindo entendimento de dados mestres, transacionais e processos críticos de negócio.
  • Certificação em gerenciamento de projetos (PMP, PMI-ACP ou equivalentes).


Diferenciais

  • Certificações SAP Activate e/ou SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência prévia em programas de transformação digital envolvendo Data & Analytics, Cloud e Integração com Databricks/Azure/AWS.
  • Vivência em ambientes multinacionais, com comunicação em inglês avançado para reuniões e documentação.
  • Conhecimento em gestão financeira de projetos (FTEs, burn rate, CAPEX/OPEX).
